_comment: Copy to signing.local.json at the repo root (git-ignored), keep one method, and fill it in. See BUILDING.md, 'Code signing'.

certificate._comment: A code-signing certificate in your Windows certificate store (also hardware tokens and cloud HSMs that expose it there). Thumbprint from: Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My -CodeSigningCert

artifactSigning._comment: For method 'artifact-signing' (Azure Artifact Signing, formerly Trusted Signing). dlib comes from Microsoft's signing client (Microsoft.ArtifactSigning.Client / Microsoft.Trusted.Signing.Client NuGet package); metadata is a JSON file with Endpoint, CodeSigningAccountName and CertificateProfileName.

_command_comment: For method 'command': any other signing tool; {file} becomes the quoted path of the file to sign.
